name: release
context_rationale: Inline orchestrator: it has an interactive overwrite gate (AskUserQuestion before clobbering a hand-written doc), writes deliverables into the live code repo, and spawns the forked product-doc agent for the narrative drafting (keeping the parent context lean). The repo writes + the overwrite gate + the vault-manifest write all need the parent conversation's tool access, so the orchestrator stays main-agent and only the README/API-ref/user-guide drafting is forked. CHANGELOG is generated deterministically by a bundled script (no model).
summary: Generates + maintains product documentation grounded in code reality. CHANGELOG.md is assembled deterministically from the per-slice changelog.json records /commit-slice writes (assemble_changelog.py); README / API-reference / user-guide are drafted by a forked product-doc agent from the code-review-graph public surface + the vault (concept, slices), with every interface fact grounded in a real CRG node — unverifiable claims are omitted, never invented. Docs are markdown DELIVERABLES written to the code repo; a doc-manifest.json provenance record is written to the vault so /drift-check can flag docs that drift from code (the stale-doc category). Out-of-loop, user-invokable, all modes. NEVER modifies source code; gates before overwriting a hand-written doc.

agents.name: product-doc
agents.when: Step 2, after the CRG public surface + vault context are gathered (skipped if only --docs changelog requested)
agents.purpose: Forked author: drafts README / API-reference / user-guide markdown from the handed CRG surface + vault context, grounding every interface fact in a real CRG node (omits, never invents, what it cannot verify), Writes each draft to a staging directory the skill provides (never the repo or vault) and returns their paths + grounding as structured product-doc-draft@2 JSON

methodology_tools.name: assemble_changelog
methodology_tools.purpose: Deterministic, dependency-free CHANGELOG generator: aggregates the per-slice changelog.json records (<vault>/slices/archive/*/changelog.json) into a Keep-a-Changelog-style CHANGELOG.md grouped by conventional-commit type (feat->Added, fix->Fixed, rest->Changed), newest-slice first. Single-skill script; no model, so the changelog never hallucinates.

external_tools.name: code-review-graph
external_tools.purpose: Harvest the public surface (entry points / exports / CLI / endpoints) that grounds the README + API reference, and the snapshot recorded in doc-manifest.json for the drift loop. External pip package (never bundled).

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read the vault (concept.json, triage.json, slices/_index.json), existing README/docs, and CRG-cited source files for grounding

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write the agent-drafted README/API-reference/user-guide to the repo and the doc-manifest.json to the vault

harness_tools.name: Edit
harness_tools.purpose: Refresh an existing hand-written doc in place when the user chooses merge over overwrite

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Resolve repo + vault roots, query code-review-graph for the public surface, and run assemble_changelog.py

harness_tools.name: Agent
harness_tools.purpose: Spawn the named product-doc author subagent (subagent_type: product-doc) for the forked narrative drafting

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: The overwrite gate — confirm before clobbering a hand-written doc not previously produced by /release

file_access.purpose: What the product is, the actors + their top actions, scope/non-goals — anchors the README narrative + the user-guide tasks
Pipeline mode (minimal/standard/heavy) — context for how much doc surface to expect
Shipped capabilities — document what exists, not aspirational features
Per-slice audit records (written by /commit-slice) — the deterministic source for CHANGELOG.md
Project README written to the CODE REPO (not the vault) — overwrite-gated if hand-written
CHANGELOG written to the CODE REPO, regenerated wholesale from changelog.json (generated artifact — no overwrite gate)
Public-surface API reference written to the CODE REPO, grounded in the CRG export list — overwrite-gated if hand-written
Task-oriented user guide written to the CODE REPO, organized around concept.json actors/actions — overwrite-gated if hand-written

Provenance anchor: which docs were generated, the CRG public-surface snapshot each was grounded in, and the source commit — read by /drift-check to flag stale-doc. Single-shot full rewrite each run (not an append-mutated shared aggregate), so raw-write is correct.
